verdict.rationale: The evidence covers end-user on-ramp and off-ramp flows: customers buy crypto via widgets, SDKs and quotes, and sell crypto for payout to a bank or card. Nothing shows the business holding fiat and stablecoin balances on the platform, or doing internal transfers or rebalancing between them through an API or dashboard. Converting between fiat and crypto is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies, but it is unevidenced here.
